long_biography.plain_text:
Former Montedison executive Carlo Sama returned to his business past through La caduta di un impero, a memoir presenting his family's account of the Ferruzzi group's collapse. He also donated the Ferruzzi-Sama archive to Ravenna's Fondazione Casa di Oriani. Its letters, diaries and working papers give researchers access to the records behind that contested industrial history.

His agricultural relationships also led to support for education. After the death of agronomist and business partner Livio Ferruzzi, Sama helped fund a memorial scholarship at North Carolina State University. Established with gifts from family, friends and associated businesses, the endowment supports North Carolina students pursuing degrees in agriculture and life sciences.
